raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-16 refactor (DE-398), silver_transactions derives txn_date from ingest_ts, the batch delivery timestamp that lands at 02:00 the next day, so every POSTED row (4630) gets the wrong date. txn_date should be the calendar date of txn_ts, as the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor expects.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
